const d = $input.item.json; const P = { HIGH: { bg:'#fff5f5', border:'#fc8181', text:'#c53030', dot:'#e53e3e' }, MEDIUM: { bg:'#fffbeb', border:'#f6ad55', text:'#c05621', dot:'#dd6b20' }, LOW: { bg:'#f0fff4', border:'#68d391', text:'#276749', dot:'#38a169' } }; const p = P[d.alertLevel] || P.MEDIUM; // Score dot indicator const dot = (score) => score >= 70 ? '🔴' : score >= 40 ? '🟡' : '🟢'; // Score row — clean single line const scoreRow = (label, score) => ` ${label} ${score}%  ${dot(score)} `; // Red flag row const flagRow = (flag) => ` ${flag} `; const now = new Date(d.analyzedAt); const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday:'long', year:'numeric', month:'long', day:'numeric' }); // EXIF one-liner const exifLine = d.exif.software ? `🚨 AI software detected in metadata: "${d.exif.software}"` : d.exif.dateTaken ? `📷 Taken: ${d.exif.dateTaken}${d.exif.camera ? ' · ' + d.exif.camera : ''}${d.exif.wasEdited ? ' · ⚠️ Edited after creation' : ''}` : d.exif.hasExif ? `📷 EXIF found · No date recorded` : `📷 No EXIF data · Likely screenshot or downloaded`; // Reverse search one-liner const serpLine = d.reverseSearch.earliestYear ? `🔍 Found ${d.reverseSearch.totalResults} prior appearance(s) · Earliest: ${d.reverseSearch.earliestYear}` : d.reverseSearch.totalResults > 0 ? `🔍 Found ${d.reverseSearch.totalResults} prior appearance(s) · No date determined` : `🔍 No prior appearances found online`; // Claim block (only if provided) const claimLine = (d.caption || d.claimDate) ? `

Submitted Claim

${d.caption ? `

📝 ${d.caption}

` : ''} ${d.claimDate ? `

📅 Claimed date: ${d.claimDate}

` : ''}
` : ''; const html = `

Powered by

सत्यता

${dateStr}  ·  ${d.fileName}

${d.verdictEmoji} ${d.finalVerdict}

${d.formula.overall}%
TRUST SCORE ${d.formula.flagged ? '🚩' : '✅'}

${d.reasoning.gemini_summary}

${claimLine}

Scores

${scoreRow('👤 Deepfake', d.scores.deepfake.combined)} ${scoreRow('🤖 AI Generated', d.scores.ai_generated.combined)} ${scoreRow('⏳ Timely / Context', d.scores.timely)}
${d.redFlags.length > 0 ? `

Red Flags

${d.redFlags.map(f => flagRow(f)).join('')}
` : `

✅ No red flags detected

`}

Evidence

${exifLine}

${serpLine}

⚠️ Automated analysis. Not 100% accurate — always verify manually for critical decisions.

सत्यता

Powered by  Wvolf  ·  dima806  ·  Gemini  ·  SerpAPI  ·  EXIF

`; return [{ json: { html, subject: `${d.verdictEmoji} सत्यता: ${d.finalVerdict} [${d.formula.overall}%] — ${d.fileName}`, postmanPayload: { status: 'success', file: d.fileName, claim: { caption: d.caption, claimed_date: d.claimDate }, verdict: { label: d.finalVerdict, emoji: d.verdictEmoji, alert_level: d.alertLevel, overall_trust_score: d.formula.overall }, scores: { deepfake: { hf: d.scores.deepfake.hf, gemini: d.scores.deepfake.gemini, combined: d.scores.deepfake.combined }, ai_generated: { hf: d.scores.ai_generated.hf, gemini: d.scores.ai_generated.gemini, combined: d.scores.ai_generated.combined }, timeliness: d.scores.timely }, formula: d.formula, red_flags: d.redFlags, evidence: { exif: d.exif, reverse_search: d.reverseSearch, gemini_reasoning: d.reasoning, gemini_verdict: d.geminiVerdict, gemini_confidence: d.geminiConfidence, inconsistencies: d.inconsistencies, context_clues: d.contextClues }, analyzed_at: d.analyzedAt } } }];
